user.title: Sheltr Cloud
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your Sheltr Cloud portal. Use the instance username and password (recommended: the token is renewed automatically) or paste an existing instance token.

data_description.token: Only needed if you do not provide username and password

reauth_confirm.title: Sheltr Cloud authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The token for instance {instance_id} is no longer valid. Enter the credentials again or paste a new token.

reconfigure.title: Sheltr Cloud settings
reconfigure.description: Update the portal address or the credentials used for this instance.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the portal at the given address.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials or token, or no access to this instance.
error.instance_not_found: No instance with this ID exists on the portal.
error.missing_auth: Provide username and password, or an instance token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log.

abort.wrong_instance: The credentials belong to a different instance.

data.poll_after_command: Verify the module state after every command

data_description.scan_interval: How often the portal state is read (no traffic towards the device).
data_description.active_poll_interval: How often the modules are actually polled over MQTT. Use 0 to disable it and rely on the Refresh button (recommended with data saver on an IoT SIM).
data_description.poll_after_command: More reliable, but it adds one poll for every command.
